Masala Chaas (Buttermilk)
By: ravikumar
Published: Friday, December 22, 2017 - 2:52am

Ingredients




Curd - 1 cup
Water - 2 cups
Salt to taste
Black pepper powder - ¼ tsp
Roasted cumin powder - ½ tsp
Mint leaves - 8-10 (very finely chopped)
Coriander leaves - 1 tsp (finely chopped)

Preparation

1 DIRECTIONS 2 Wondering what drink to serve your kids this weekend? Something that is yummy and healthy at the same time. Well, Neha makes this tasty Masala Chaas or Buttermilk for her son, and she swears by it. 3 Method: 4 1. Whisk curd till smooth. Add water and whisk again to form froth on top. 5 2. Add all the remaining ingredients. Serve chilled.

About

Masala Chaas (Buttermilk) Recipe is a Healthy and Delicious drink you can have any time of the day. Buttermilk is one of India’s favourite cool drink during the hot summer day and even want to feel full of refreshment. Masala Chaas Recipe or Buttermilk recipe is quick and easy to make within a couple of minutes.
